::: {#fig-quasi-newton-step-3d fig-alt="Surface plot of the quadratic function f over first coordinates from -0.4 to 0.6 and second coordinates from -0.2 to 1, a bowl-shaped surface whose lowest point is above the point (0.09, 0.64).
Three markers lie on the surface.
A blue circle at the origin is the starting point, a vermilion circle above (0.25, 0.5) is the iterate after one step, and a blue square above (0.09, 0.64) is the minimizer, at the bottom of the bowl."}

::: {.panel-tabset group="language"}

### R

```{r}
#| label: quasi-newton-step-3d-r
#| echo: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
#| eval: !expr knitr::is_html_output()
qn3_x_3d <- seq(-0.4, 0.6, length.out = 101)
qn3_y_3d <- seq(-0.2, 1, length.out = 101)
qn3_f_3d <- function(x, y) {
  quad <- 0.5 * (4 * x^2 + 2 * x * y + 3 * y^2)
  quad - x - 2 * y
}
qn3_z_3d <- outer(qn3_y_3d, qn3_x_3d, qn3_f_3d)
qn3_x_pts_3d <- c(0, 0.25, 1 / 11)
qn3_y_pts_3d <- c(0, 0.5, 7 / 11)
qn3_z_pts_3d <- qn3_f_3d(qn3_x_pts_3d, qn3_y_pts_3d)
qn3_labels_3d <- c("start", "after one step", "minimizer")
qn3_pts_3d <- tibble::tibble(
  x = qn3_x_pts_3d,
  y = qn3_y_pts_3d,
  z = qn3_z_pts_3d,
  label = qn3_labels_3d,
  color = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#0072B2"),
  symbol = c("circle", "circle", "square")
)
qn3_marker_3d <- list(color = ~color, size = 6, symbol = ~symbol)

plotly::plot_ly() |>
  plotly::add_surface(
    x = qn3_x_3d,
    y = qn3_y_3d,
    z = qn3_z_3d,
    colorscale = list(c(0, 1), c("#E5E5E5", "#808080")),
    showscale = FALSE,
    opacity = 0.7
  ) |>
  plotly::add_markers(
    data = qn3_pts_3d,
    x = ~x,
    y = ~y,
    z = ~z,
    text = ~label,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    showlegend = FALSE,
    marker = qn3_marker_3d
  ) |>
  plotly::layout(
    scene = list(
      xaxis = list(title = "first coordinate"),
      yaxis = list(title = "second coordinate"),
      zaxis = list(title = "f(x)"),
      camera = list(eye = list(x = 1.6, y = -1.6, z = 0.9))
    ),
    legend = list(orientation = "h")
  )
```

### Python

```{python}
#| label: quasi-newton-step-3d-python
#| fig-alt: >-
#|   Surface plot of the quadratic function f over first coordinates from
#|   -0.4 to 0.6 and second coordinates from -0.2 to 1, a bowl-shaped surface
#|   whose lowest point is above the point (0.09, 0.64). Three markers lie on
#|   the surface. A blue circle at the origin is the starting point, a
#|   vermilion circle above (0.25, 0.5) is the iterate after one step, and a
#|   blue square above (0.09, 0.64) is the minimizer, at the bottom of the
#|   bowl.
#| fig-height: 4.5
#| fig-width: 6
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import numpy as np

qn_x_3d = np.linspace(-0.4, 0.6, 101)
qn_y_3d = np.linspace(-0.2, 1, 101)
qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d = np.meshgrid(qn_x_3d, qn_y_3d)


def qn_f_3d(x, y):
    return 0.5 * (4 * x**2 + 2 * x * y + 3 * y**2) - x - 2 * y


qn_pts_x_3d = np.array([0, 0.25, 1 / 11])
qn_pts_y_3d = np.array([0, 0.5, 7 / 11])
qn_pts_z_3d = qn_f_3d(qn_pts_x_3d, qn_pts_y_3d)
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(6, 4.5))
ax = fig.add_subplot(projection="3d")
ax.plot_surface(qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d, qn_f_3d(qn_xx_3d, qn_yy_3d),
                color="grey", alpha=0.4)
ax.scatter(qn_pts_x_3d[0], qn_pts_y_3d[0], qn_pts_z_3d[0], marker="o",
           color="#0072B2", s=50, label="start")
ax.scatter(qn_pts_x_3d[1], qn_pts_y_3d[1], qn_pts_z_3d[1], marker="o",
           color="#D55E00", s=50, label="after one step")
ax.scatter(qn_pts_x_3d[2], qn_pts_y_3d[2], qn_pts_z_3d[2], marker="s",
           color="#0072B2", s=50, label="minimizer")
ax.set_xlabel("first coordinate")
ax.set_ylabel("second coordinate")
ax.set_zlabel("f(x)")
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.show();
```

:::

The [graph](functions.qmd#def-graph) of the [quadratic function](algebra-exponentials.qmd#def-quadratic-polynomial) $f$ from @exm-quasi-newton-step,
the surface whose [level curves](vector-calculus.qmd#def-level-set) are in @fig-quasi-newton-step.
The start $\vx^{(0)} = \vzero$ (blue circle),
the iterate $\vx^{(1)}$ after one [steepest-descent](#def-gradient-descent) step (vermilion circle),
and the [minimizer](algebra.qmd#def-global-minimizer) (blue square) at the bottom of the bowl are marked on the surface.

:::
